name: Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Court Purple'
story_html: The Nike Kobe 8 Protro 'Court Purple' showcases an all-over print made up of the jersey numbers that Kobe Bryant wore during his 20-year career with the Los Angeles Lakers. '8' and '24' are arranged in a repeating pattern throughout the white engineered mesh upper, secured with purple laces and equipped with a padded low-cut collar. A drop-in React foam midsole delivers lightweight cushioning with each step. Underfoot, a violet-tinged translucent rubber reveals a carbon fiber shank plate for midfoot stability.
